To determine which paranormal phenomena have been shown by experiments to be real, we evaluate the scientific consensus regarding paranormal claims. Despite extensive research in parapsychology over many decades, no paranormal phenomenon (such as ESP, telepathy, precognition, ghosts, psychokinesis, etc.) has been consistently and replicably demonstrated to be real under controlled scientific laboratory conditions. Therefore, the scientifically supported statement is that no paranormal phenomena have been shown by experiments to be real.

Looking at the options:
(A) Precognition has been shown to be real.
(B) Psychics have been shown to be real.
(C) Ghosts has been shown to be real.
(D) No paranormal phenomena have been shown by experiments to be real.
(E) Demons have been shown to be real.
(F) Telepathy has been shown to be real.
(G) Reincarnation has been shown to be real.
(H) ESP has been show by experiments to be real.
(I) Psychokinesis has been shown to be real.

Option (D) correctly reflects the current consensus of the scientific community.

Final answer: D
